title: Concept: Dependency version declared as an open range
description: pom.xml declares a version range with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version range with no upper bound.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a version range with no upper bound.
